_comment: Power Church's own HVAC hours, expressed in the panel's three built-in modes (Unoccupied, Employee, Customer). Outside every window units fall to default_mode. Inside a window they go to that window's mode. The Pi re-arms the override while a window is active. enabled:false means the schedule is DORMANT and changes nothing until turned on. Times are 24-hour in the timezone below. Edit and the scheduler picks it up within a minute, no restart needed.
